user.title: Price Source
user.description: Select your Nordpool electricity price sensor.

data_description.nordpool_sensor: Select the Nordpool sensor that provides your electricity prices. Both the official HA Nordpool and the HACS Nordpool integration are supported.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Choose which energy management modules to enable. You can change this later.

data_description.battery_enabled: Enable home battery charge/discharge scheduling based on electricity prices.
data_description.ev_enabled: Enable EV charging optimization with price-aware scheduling.
data_description.appliances_enabled: Enable switching selected appliances on and off based on solar surplus (grid export).

battery.title: Home Battery
battery.description: Configure your home battery system. Entities are auto-detected from SigenStor.

data_description.soc_entity: Sensor showing battery state of charge (%).
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Total usable battery capacity in kWh.
data_description.forecast_solar_entity: Optional Forecast.Solar "remaining today" sensor(s) for solar-aware scheduling -- select one or more (e.g. east + west arrays); their readings are summed. Leave empty if not available.
data_description.charge_buffer_pct: Extra percentage added on top of the calculated charge deficit before scheduling charge slots.
data_description.production_factor: Multiplier applied to the solar forecast reading to account for forecast optimism (1.0 = trust the forecast fully).
data_description.estimated_charge_power_kw: Assumed charging rate used to size how many slots are needed to cover a charge deficit (capped by the max charging power number entity).
data_description.peak_gap_hours: Maximum gap between expensive hours to still treat them as the same discharge peak.

ems.title: EMS Control
ems.description: Configure fuse protection and battery control entities. Control entities are auto-detected from SigenStor.

data_description.fuse_rating_amps: Your main fuse rating in amps. Used to calculate safe charging limits.
data_description.fuse_safety_buffer_amps: Advanced: extra safety margin subtracted from the fuse rating before any charging headroom is calculated.
data_description.ems_select_entity: Select entity controlling the SigenStor EMS mode.
data_description.charge_limit_entity: Number entity for max battery charging limit (kW).
data_description.discharge_limit_entity: Number entity for max battery discharging limit (kW).
data_description.grid_power_entity: Fallback: total grid active power (kW or W), signed (positive = import, negative = export). Used only when per-phase sensors are not configured.
data_description.grid_phase_a_entity: Per-phase grid power sensor for phase A (kW or W), signed (positive = import, negative = export). For 3-phase fuse protection, configure all three phases.
data_description.grid_phase_b_entity: Per-phase grid power sensor for phase B (kW or W), signed (positive = import, negative = export).
data_description.grid_phase_c_entity: Per-phase grid power sensor for phase C (kW or W), signed (positive = import, negative = export).
data_description.pv_power_entity: Sensor showing current PV/solar power output (W).
data_description.sensor_fail_behavior: Advanced: what to do when the grid current sensors are unavailable, unknown, or not configured. 'Assume load' keeps charging using an assumed load estimate; 'Block' pauses battery charging entirely until sensors recover.
data_description.assumed_load_amps: Advanced: load in amps to assume when current sensors are unavailable and the behavior above is 'Assume load'.
data_description.max_ess_charge_amps: Advanced: hard safety cap on the battery's own charging current, independent of fuse headroom.
data_description.ess_increase_delay: Advanced: how long a higher charge limit must stay stable before it is applied. Decreases always apply immediately.

ev.title: EV Charging
ev.description: Configure your EV charger. Entities are auto-detected from Easee.

data.battery_soc_gate_pct: Battery SOC gate for solar charging (%)

data_description.charger_device_id: Auto-detected HA device ID of the Easee charger, used to address the easee.* control services. Leave the auto-detected value unless it is wrong -- or leave it empty for a non-Easee charger: commands are then never sent and you automate on the command sensors instead.
data_description.house_consumption_entity: Sensor showing total house power consumption, used for solar-surplus charging. Auto-detected from SigenStor.
data_description.excluded_power_entities: Optional: power sensors to subtract from house consumption (e.g. a separately-managed water heater) before computing solar surplus.
data_description.notify_service: Optional notify service (e.g. 'notify.mobile_app_x') for safety notifications. Leave empty to disable notifications.
data_description.min_charge_amps: Advanced: the lowest current the charger will ever be set to (Easee minimum is 6A).
data_description.max_charge_amps: Advanced: the highest current the charger will ever be set to.
data_description.max_grid_charge_power_kw: Advanced: absolute grid charging power ceiling.
data_description.amp_increase_delay: Advanced: how long a higher charging current must stay stable before it is applied.
data_description.amp_decrease_delay: Advanced: how long a lower charging current must stay stable before it is applied. Always much shorter than the increase delay -- this is a safety property.
data_description.phase_switch_threshold_kw: Advanced: available power below which the charger switches to single-phase charging.
data_description.solar_start_threshold_kw: Advanced: minimum net solar surplus to start opportunistic solar charging.
data_description.solar_activation_delay: Advanced: how long solar surplus must be continuously available before solar charging activates.
data_description.solar_deactivation_delay: Advanced: how long solar surplus must be continuously unavailable before solar charging deactivates.
data_description.battery_soc_gate_pct: Advanced: minimum house battery charge level before solar charging is allowed to divert surplus to the car.
data_description.emergency_margin_amps: Advanced: amps above the fuse rating that triggers an emergency pause and notification.

economics.title: Economics
economics.description: Electricity fees and battery charging power. These values seed the tunable number entities — you can adjust them anytime later from the Energy Manager device page.

data_description.battery_cycle_cost: Wear cost per charged kWh. When above 0, the discharge threshold is derived automatically as cycle cost minus grid transfer fee.
data_description.grid_transfer_fee: Your grid operator's transfer fee, added to the spot price.
data_description.electricity_company_fee: Your electricity supplier's markup, added to the spot price.
data_description.max_charge_power: Maximum power used when grid-charging the home battery.

finish.title: Setup complete
finish.description:
Energy Manager is ready. Two things before it takes any action:

- Add your car(s) with the 'Add car' button on the integration page to enable scheduled EV charging.
- Device control starts OFF (observe-only): the integration only logs what it would do until you turn on the 'Device control' switch.

finish_basic.title: Setup complete
finish_basic.description: Energy Manager is ready. Device control starts OFF (observe-only): the integration only logs what it would do until you turn on the 'Device control' switch.

error.nordpool_not_found: Could not find a valid Nordpool sensor. Please verify the entity exists and the Nordpool integration is loaded.

user.title: Add Car
user.description: Configure a car for charging optimization. Entities are auto-detected from Skoda/VW integrations.

data.phase_capability: Charger phases used by this car

data_description.car_name: A friendly name for this car (e.g., 'Enyaq', 'Family Car').
data_description.battery_capacity: Total battery capacity of the car in kWh.
data_description.battery_level_entity: Sensor showing the car's battery level (%).
data_description.charger_connected_entity: Optional: binary sensor from the car integration showing if the charger cable is connected. Auto-detected from Skoda/VW integrations.
data_description.location_entity: Optional: device tracker from the car integration showing the vehicle location. Used to confirm the car is home.
data_description.phase_capability: How many of the charger's phases this car actually draws on when it is in 3-phase mode. Most cars use all 3; some (e.g. VW ID.3) only use 2.

user.title: Add Appliance
user.description: Configure an appliance to run on solar surplus. It is switched on when grid export exceeds its rated power with margin, and off when the surplus disappears.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this appliance (e.g., 'Water heater').
data_description.switch_entity: The switch or input boolean Energy Manager toggles to control this appliance (e.g. a smart plug or a Power Saver override switch).
data_description.rated_power_w: Expected power draw of the appliance when running, in watts.
data_description.phases: Number of phases the appliance draws on (1 or 3). Used to convert rated power to per-phase current for the fuse admission check.
data_description.power_sensor_entity: Optional: sensor measuring the appliance's actual power draw. If set, the measured draw is used instead of the rated power when crediting the appliance's consumption back to the surplus pool.
data_description.priority: Allocation priority when several appliances compete for the surplus (1 = highest). Ties are broken by the order the appliances were added.
data_description.on_threshold_pct: Turn on when the available surplus reaches this percentage of the rated power, sustained.
data_description.off_threshold_pct: Turn off when the available surplus stays below this percentage of the rated power, sustained.
data_description.on_sustain_minutes: How long the surplus must persist before the appliance is turned on (filters passing clouds).
data_description.off_sustain_minutes: How long the surplus must be gone before the appliance is turned off.
data_description.min_on_minutes: Once turned on, the appliance stays on at least this long (anti-short-cycling).
data_description.min_off_minutes: Once turned off, the appliance stays off at least this long (anti-short-cycling).

data_description.min_on_minutes: Once turned on, the appliance stays on at least this long (anti-short-cycling).

fuse_sensor_fallback.title: Fuse protection running on fallback
fuse_sensor_fallback.description: Fuse protection has been running without live grid readings ({sensor}) for more than 5 minutes and is using the configured {behavior} fallback. Check the grid sensors, or update them in the Energy Manager EMS options.

charge_limit_wrong_domain.title: Charge limit entity is not a number entity
charge_limit_wrong_domain.description: The configured charge limit entity {entity_id} is not in the 'number' domain, so charge limit commands are skipped. Select a writable number entity in the Energy Manager EMS options.

discharge_limit_wrong_domain.title: Discharge limit entity is not a number entity
discharge_limit_wrong_domain.description: The configured discharge limit entity {entity_id} is not in the 'number' domain, so discharge limit commands are skipped. Select a writable number entity in the Energy Manager EMS options.
